Description

A pale scorpion with a calm aura but fierce determination.

Defense

AC 25, touch 11; flat-footed 23 (+2 Dex, +14 natural, -1 size)

hp 162 [216] (12d10+96)

Fort +16, Ref +10, Will +11

DR 10/evil; Immune Death Effects, Holy, Mind-affecting, Outsider traits, Petrification/Statue, Poison, Sap; Resist lightning 10, ice 10, fire 10; SR 20;

Offense

Speed 60 ft.

Melee 2 Claws +18 (1d6+7), Sting +19 (1d6+7 plus poison)

Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.

Special Attacks Rapid Stinging, Rend (2 claws, 2d6+7), Sudden Strike

Statistics

Str 24, Dex 14, Con 26, Int 10, Wis 20, Cha 10

Base Atk +12; CMB +20 (+24 grapple); CMD 32 (36 vs. trip)

Feats Cleave, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Power Attack, Skill Focus (Perception), Weapon Focus (Sting)

Skills Climb +27, Diplomacy +10, Intimidate +9, Knowledge (religion) +9, Perception +19, Sense Motive +10, Stealth +11, Swim +20; Racial Modifiers +8 Climb, +4 Perception, +4 Stealth;

Languages Celestial

Sting — injury; save Fort DC 24; frequency 1/round for 4 rounds; effect 2d6 holy damage; cure 1 save.

effect: Once per round, four rounds. One successful save cures.
Resolve Poison after a successful Sting attack.

description.value: Once every 1d4+1 rounds as a standard action, a forgiven folly releases a holy blast line with a 50 ft. range and 10 ft. wide line. Every enemy within the radius must make a Will Save (DC 21) for half damage or be inflicted with Confused status effect for 1d4 rounds and take 6d6 points of holy damage.

effect: Enemies in 10-ft-wide line: half and no confusion on save, confused 1d4 rounds on failure.

description.value: A forgiven folly's stinger strikes with astounding speed; it can make one additional attack in a round with its sting as a swift action.

effect: One additional sting this round; injury inflicts Poison.

description.value: A forgiven folly is adept at moving quickly when its foes are surprised. During a surprise round, a forgiven folly may act as if it had a full round to act, rather than just one standard action.

effect: May take a full round of actions during a surprise round.
